rationale: Both Asoma and Saori are researchers at Resonac working in materials science, giving them deep shared context on the company's focus areas in functional materials and semiconductors. While Asoma's expertise spans computational chemistry, molecular dynamics simulation, and materials informatics, Saori's background in materials science offers complementary depth—this pairing could spark cross-functional collaboration on projects bridging simulation and experimental materials development.
intro_message: Asoma Yuichiro, meet SAORI MIURA — you're both researchers at Resonac, and your work in computational materials science and materials science could open up interesting conversations on simulation-to-synthesis pipelines.
